title: Set up your workspace
subtitle: A few choices so Bokito matches how you work. You can change everything later.
memberSubtitle: Choose your language and how you want to be notified.
loadError: Could not load setup. Try again.

intake.title: Tell us a bit about you
intake.subtitle: This helps tailor setup. It is not shared outside your workspace.

languages.title: Languages
languages.subtitle: Your interface language, and the language agents use when writing for the team.
languages.workspaceHint: Used for operator chats, summaries and setup.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Bokito sorts notices into three tiers. Pick how each reaches you; refine per event later under Settings.
notifications.hint: Push only reaches you when you are not in the app. Enable browser push under Settings > Notifications.

govern.title: How much should agents do on their own?
govern.subtitle: You can change this anytime in Govern.

agent.title: Name your first agent
agent.subtitle: This is the lead assistant for your workspace. Pick a name and icon.

channel.title: Connect a channel (optional)
channel.subtitle: Create a Bokito address or connect a mailbox so customer mail can arrive. You can skip and do this from Setup.

done.title: You are ready
done.body: Next we will show you around the app.
